clauses.english: Go to him, and ask his name.

clauses.speaker: user
clauses.english: Shall I seize my bow?

clauses.speaker: model
clauses.english: Leave the bow, and hand him water.

clauses.speaker: user
clauses.english: I am going; I do not fear him.
